description:
Cast Undying Malice by paying {B}, targeting Vampire Charmseeker.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Vampire Charmseeker, adding {B}.
When Vampire Charmseeker dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Vampire Charmseeker enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Undying Malice from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
